_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Computer Aided Chip Development Data
summary: Computer Aided Chip Development Data documents fabrication of a chip using computer aids and is used by the Government to evaluate the reliability of the integrated circuit device produced by the contractor.
use_relationship:
Computer Aided Chip Development Data documents fabrication of a chip using computer aids.
This data product is used by the Government to evaluate the reliability of the integrated circuit device produced by the contractor.
This Data Item Description (DID) contains the format and content preparation Instructions for the data product generated by the specific and discrete task requirement as delineated in the contract.
This DID supercedes DI-MCCR-80499.
This DID is related to DI-MCCR-80500A, Computer Aided Cell Development Data.
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

children.title: The contractor shall prepare and deliver cell development data in accordance with the following
The contractor shall utilize and submit the computer aided cell development data on digital media in the following order of preference
The contractor shall utilize electronic media, in accordance with the instructions for digital submissions, for all other documentation and reports.
Chip description data.
children.content: This data shall uniquely describe each chip. It shall include.

children.title: Net list.
children.content: Cell connectivity data which may be derived from logic description. Note: Net list shall be provided as a simulation model, preferably Verilog or VHDL formats. Other formats shall be considered, with approval at the discretion of the Government Program Manager.

children.title: Chip specification (mechanical).
children.content: Include bonding pad identification, bonding program, package specifications, labeling instructions, and packing specifications. Note: Format for chip specification (mechanical) data shall be in the form of electronic drawings.
